events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: The legendary Rolling Stones frontman, Sir Mick Jagger, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young and still moving like Jagger! Wishing a very happy birthday to the one and only Sir Mick Jagger. What's your favourite Stones track?

events.title: MTV launched (1981)
events.blurb: MTV, the first 24-hour music video channel, launched in the US, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' being the first video ever played.

angles.name: MTV Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the day music television changed forever? 45 years ago, MTV launched with The Buggles' iconic 'Video Killed The Radio Star'. Did it kill the radio star? You tell us!

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their seminal debut album 'Definitely Maybe' in 1994, featuring classics like 'Supersonic' and 'Live Forever'.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: 32 years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the game. Which track from their debut still gives you goosebumps?

events.title: Woodstock Festival 57th anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a three-day festival of peace and music, took place in upstate New York in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Remembered
angles.copy: 57 years ago, half a million people gathered for three days of peace, love, and music at Woodstock. What an incredible moment in history!

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's death
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977, he would have been 91.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to the one and only King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley. His music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Anniversary of Tupac Shakur's death
events.blurb: Remembering influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who was shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996 and would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of a true hip-hop legend, Tupac Shakur. His powerful lyrics and legacy live on.

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's death
events.blurb: Remembering guitar icon Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970 and would have been 84.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: A true guitar hero, Jimi Hendrix, left us on this day. His innovative sound continues to shape music decades later.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in 1969, featuring the iconic zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: It's been 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in music history!

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' formidable frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! A true rock trailblazer and an absolute icon.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The outspoken former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: LG Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite track from the king of swagger? As you were.

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine released (1971)
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo album 'Imagine', featuring the timeless title track, in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released (2001)
events.blurb: Apple launched the first-generation iPod, revolutionising how people listened to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? 25 years ago, Apple unveiled the original iPod, changing music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles legend John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! A true master of British comedy. What's your favourite sketch or character?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's been 58 years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. What's your standout track from it?
